purpose: Reset Supabase authentication data without touching instructor or schedule records.
instructions: Export instructors (optional): select id, branch_id, nickname, auth_user_id, last_login_at from public.instructors order by nickname;
Clear linkages: update public.instructors set auth_user_id = null, last_login_at = null;
Delete Auth users: delete from auth.users;
Verify: select count(*) from auth.users; and ensure instructors have null auth_user_id
warnings: Do NOT delete rows from public.instructors or schedule tables.
Only authentication linkages and auth.users are being cleared.
